name: ICE Data Services
description: Query real-time and historical bond trades across corporate, agency and securitized products reported to FINRA TRACE, and municipal bond trades reported to MSRB RTRS. Look up bond reference data including coupon details and maturity dates.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ICE Data Services to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ICE Data Services to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fids-mcp.ice.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ICE Data Services MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ICE Data Services provides these MCP tools: ids_query_trades, ids_get_reference_data, ids_describe_concept, ids_get_schema, ids_classify_trade_size, and ids_compute.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ICE Data Services?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ICE Data Services in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does ICE Data Services MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ICE Data Services requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ICE Data Services is developed by Intercontinental Exchange, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
